takeaway: With three forecasts scored, the radar's ranking has improved each day (rank correlation 0.55, 0.66, 0.71). The self-tuner ran for the first time and held: its best change, weighing stated gains slightly less, helped on every day but by too little to clear the bar.

findings.heading: Three forecasts scored, each better than the last
findings.text: Rank correlation with the growth that followed: 0.55 (Oct 19), 0.66 (Oct 20), 0.71 (Oct 21). Top-15 hit rate 53%, 60%, 60%, against 25% to 33% for random picks (15 of 46 to 59 apps).

findings.heading: The self-tuner's first run: no change
findings.text: Best candidate: weight on stated gains 1.0 to 0.9, mean rank correlation 0.646 to 0.650, better on all 3 days. The bar is +0.02, so nothing moved. It points the same way as the scorecards: stale stated gains over-rank apps.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill passes 50,000 stars
findings.text: It reached 50,560 and leads the weekly trending page for a fourth day (+16,388). Its daily pace has settled at about 1,500 to 1,700.

findings.heading: Design skills are the most crowded fast-moving category
findings.text: hallmark gained 2,316 stars and impeccable 1,452 in a day, and elayadesign/ai-design-skills is new on trending with 10.0k stars from 8 commits.

findings.heading: Local agent workspaces are converging
findings.text: nightly-labs/openbot grew 58% in a day after three releases; makecindy/cindy and JetBrains thinkrail also grew strongly this week. Each runs and steers several coding agents on one machine.

caveats: Three matured forecasts are still a small sample; the tuner's bar keeps noise-sized gains from moving any setting.
Both weight settings are capped at 1.0, so the tuner can favour measured growth only by weighing stated gains less.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; one duplicate growth claim was dropped before ingest.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
